---
title: "A Small Computational Graph fletcher"
format:
  typst: default
---
```{=typst}
#import "@preview/fletcher:0.5.8" as fletcher: diagram, node, edge
#import "@preview/diverential:0.3.0": *


#figure(
  align(center)[
    #diagram(
      cell-size: 18mm,
      node-shape: circle,
      node-stroke: 0.8pt + rgb("#3B6EA5"),
      node-fill: rgb("#EAF2FF"),
      node-inset: 3pt,

      // Forward computation: solid blue arrows.
      node((0, 0), $x$, name: <x>),
      node((0, 1), $y$, name: <y>),
      node((1, 0.5), $u = x + y$, name: <u>),
      node((2, 0.5), $f = u y$, name: <f>),

      edge(<x>, "-|>", <u>, stroke: rgb("#3B6EA5")),
      edge(<y>, "-|>", <u>, stroke: rgb("#3B6EA5")),
      edge(<u>, "-|>", <f>, stroke: rgb("#3B6EA5")),
      edge(<y>, <f>, "-|>", bend: -25deg, stroke: rgb("#3B6EA5")),

      // Reverse pass: dashed red arrows.
      edge(
        <f>, <u>, "<|-",
        bend: 15deg,
        stroke: 1pt + rgb("#C53030"),
        label: $dvp(f,u)  = y$,
        label-pos: 0.5,
        label-side: left,
      ),
      edge(
        <u>, <x>, "<|-",
        bend: 15deg,
        stroke: 1pt + rgb("#C53030"),
        label: $dvp(f,x)  = y$,
        label-pos: 0.55,
        label-side: left,
      )
    )
  ],
  caption: [
    Solid blue arrows show the forward evaluation.
    Dashed red arrows show selected reverse-mode derivatives.
  ],
)
```
